_comment_prefix_list_file: Optional. Path to a text file of 216-bit prefixes to check first, one per line (54 hex chars each; blank lines and '#' comments ignored). They are handed out in file order before any random prefix; expired blocks still take priority. Loading is idempotent across restarts. Omit to go straight to random assignment.
_comment_space_prefix: Optional. Omit (or leave empty) to draw random 216-bit prefixes from the full 2^216 space. Set to a hex string shorter than 54 chars to pin the high-order bits, e.g. to split the space across independent servers.
